captions.detailed: A pair of compact folding binoculars with a dark matte finish. It features two slim cylindrical optical barrels connected to a central hinge system, allowing them to fold inward or outward to adjust for interpupillary distance. A central cylindrical focus wheel is mounted on the bridge, while one of the eyepieces features a distinct diopter adjustment ring. The lenses have a dark blue reflection, and the mechanical joints are highlighted in contrasting gray.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of compact folding binoculars with two dark cylindrical barrels attached to a central hinge. Ensure the barrels can adjust via a revolute joint for eye distance, and include a central rotating focus wheel and a diopter ring on one eyepiece.
captions.factory: The code defines an ArticulatedObject representing the binoculars. It models the main bridge as the base frame, adding a central focus wheel via a continuous rotation joint. Two separate arm segments (left and right) are attached to the bridge using revolute joints to simulate folding. Cylindrical optical barrels with lenses are then attached to these folding arms, with one barrel featuring an additional continuous joint for the diopter adjustment ring.
